text: A robed stranger appears one night, offering his help for a small fee. Do you accept the help?
The Stranger
An elven messanger arrives, looking for an Idrinth. The Idrinth you know has avoided him so far, maybe you could help?
A wood elf ranger arrives at your camp site. Stating that he is in need of his bloodied cousin. While Idrinth quickly confirms, that he was meant, he refuses to meet.
An old scholar approaches your camp. Carrying books of the past, she claims to have found valuable knowledge for you.
At night, while an icy wind tortures your guards, they catch a kislevite trying to sneak into the camp. He is young and seemingly harmless, but what do you do with him?
One night you find one of your servants drained of blood right outside Idrinth's tent. Rushing in, you find him reading an old scroll sitting at his table.
The Messeger
Blood Cousins
Intruder!
The Scholar
The Servant's End
A group of dwarves have been spotted nearby. Your scouts have listened in on their stories about the vampire wars. One elf mentioned sounds suspiciously like Idrinth.
An old feud
After the latest hunt Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven weapon. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
A Blessed Weapon
After the latest battle Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven armour. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
A Blessed Armour
After the finishing travel for the day Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven talisman. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
A Blessed Talisman

Activate stricter lore friendliness to limit the recruiting cultures for Knight-Scholar Idrinth Thalui to High Elves, Wood Elves, Kislev, The Empire and Vampire Counts. Choose looser mode to have Vampire Coast, Legions of Nagash, Dark Elves, Cathay and Bretonia in the list as well.
Mode: Stricter or Looser Lore Friendliness

After accepting your coin the stranger introduces himself as a fellow Asur named Idrinth. Taking off his travel robes you see the battle worn armor of a lore master, a matching greatsword and a metal bow near stoic eyes hinting at brutalities yet to be committed.
Idrinth Thalui

I look forward to fighting alongside the hunters of the woods, cousin, states the asur in a friendly tone while packing his payment and travel cloak. I may not be as great of a shot as you are, but I won't slow you down. A slightly amused smile plays around his bloodless lips before disappearing. Let us have a hunt that will be told of in centuries still!
Idrinth Thalui

The stranger disrobes himself after having been payed and reveals an elven face and elven weaponry beneath his travel robes. My name is Idrinth, I have been fighting our foes for longer than most of you have lived. I would enjoy practicing with the force and teaching them. A slight smile plays around his bloodless lips before it disappears in an ageless face.
Idrinth Thalui

I have fought and bled with warriors believing in Ulfic or Sigmar. We have the same foes, he states as he removes his travel robes, and I look forward to driving them back with you. Sharing my knowledge for the betterment of the world. His eyes look coldly at praying humans before returning their attention to the general and his guard.
Idrinth Thalui

The stranger lowers his hood, revealing elven features. I am no friend of destruction, but our enemies forced my hand. Pocketing his coins he states, Returning to family after many years when they are in danger is right, no matter who that family is. Don't you agree?
Idrinth Thalui
Idrinth informs you, that his gods have decided to act to support your cause. Your armies will be more powerful from a divine blessing for a while.
The Gods' Favour
